Elliot, Priya — adding the rubric and some concrete scoring guidance here so we can lock the evaluation design before kickoff. Attachment: sapphire_eval_schema.csv (format) and a short scoring template in the Drive link below.

Scoring rubric (proposed, please review)
- Exact match / structured label accuracy (triage_level): micro F1 and confusion matrix per label.
- Follow-up needed (binary): precision, recall, F1; penalty for false negatives higher (missed follow-up risk).
- Harm risk score: human raters mark 1–5; any avg >=4 flagged for immediate review.
- Actionability: 1–5 scale on whether the generated suggested message is clear & directly usable by care team.

Evaluation buckets/slices we recommend:
- Chronic vs acute case samples
- Age groups (pediatric/adult/geriatric) if provided
- Short vs long notes (sequence length > 512 tokens)

Model recommendations (high level)
- q4_7b-lowlat: best 95th-percentile latency (sub-500ms typical on Dedicated v2), good baseline precision after prompt tuning.
- q8_13b-balanced: stronger on precision and F1, higher tail latency (~650–800ms p95).
- float16_70b-highqual: highest quality for edge cases, costliest, reserve for targeted regression checks.

Data ingest & secure intake checklist
- CSV columns must match sapphire_eval_schema.csv exactly; patient identifiers must be removed per checklist.
- Transfer: SFTP inbound OR secure Redwood intake link — we will send upload credentials once PO is in place.

Operational ask to Sapphire before kickoff
1) Approve rubric (attach edits to this thread).
2) Confirm preferred scoring slices and any compliance constraints on human reviewers.
3) Share a contact for procurement to accelerate PO/formal onboarding.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SapphireEvalDriveLink (scoring template + prompt bank + model recs).
